content: gvenzl/oracle-free (docker.io/gvenzl/oracle-free, mirrored ghcr.io/gvenzl/oracle-free) is the de facto community-standard Oracle Database Free container image for local dev/CI, built from Oracle's official binaries via oracle/docker-images build scripts. Latest release as of research date: 23.26.2, with tag variants full / slim / (default) and a -faststart suffix that ships a pre-built datafile set to cut container startup from minutes to seconds — valuable for local dev and CI. Recommend pinning an explicit immutable tag like 23.26.2-faststart (or 23.26.2-slim-faststart for a smaller image) rather than 'latest'. Official container-registry.oracle.com images exist too but are the enterprise/official distribution channel with less convenient tagging for this scale of project.
